title: Multiplicity One Property for Archimedean Theta Correspondence
summary: For any archimedean reductive dual pair, we prove that the Jordan-Hölder multiplicity of the small theta lift in the full theta lift is one. The main input is an equality between the multiplicities of the lowest degree $K$-types in the full and small theta lifts. We also deduce a new description of the archimedean theta correspondence in terms of lowest degree K-types.
